FN-5CTW66-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 103
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/10/2023
Senate Bill 103 as introduced will not directly affect state or local funding.
Page 1

FN-5CTW66-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 103
Committee: Ethics and Campaign Finance Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/08/2023
Senate Bill 103 as passed the Senate would increase the obligations of the State Ethics
Commission by an undetermined amount, according to the commission, dependent on the
compensation of additional staff required to perform the duties required by this bill.
Page 1

FN-5CTW66-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 103
Committee: Ethics and Campaign Finance Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/10/2023
Senate Bill 103 as reported by the Committee on Ethics and Campaign Finance would increase
the obligations of the State Ethics Commission by an undetermined amount, according to the
commission, dependent on the compensation of additional staff required to perform the duties
required by this bill.
Page 1
